data.text: Individuals who do not meet the criteria for participation in this study (screen failure) due to a reason that is expected to resolve or has resolved may be rescreened based on discussion and agreement between the Investigator and the Medical Monitor. Rescreened participants are not required to reconsent as long as they have signed the latest version of the ICF.
data.sourceSection: Section 5.4 Screen Failures

data.text: If vital signs are abnormal as defined by inclusion/exclusion criteria, 2 additional vital signs measurements will be made. The average of the 3 vital signs measurements will be recorded in the CRF and used to determine participant eligibility.
data.sourceSection: Section 8.2.2 Vital Signs

data.text: As with vital signs, if ECG interval measurements are abnormal, an additional triplicate will be performed and recorded in the CRF.
data.sourceSection: Section 8.2.3 Electrocardiograms

data.text: All SAEs will be recorded and reported to Alexion or the designee immediately and under no circumstance should this exceed 24 hours. The Investigator will submit any updated SAE data to Alexion within 24 hours of it being available.

data.text: Open_ended and non_leading verbal questioning of the participant is the preferred method to inquire about AE occurrences.
data.sourceSection: Section 8.3.2 Method of Detecting AEs and SAEs

data.text: A single biobanked serum sample will be collected predose from each participant to serve as a retained sample during the study. Samples will remain on site and will be discarded following the completion of the clinical study report. The sample will not be used for genetic testing.
data.sourceSection: Section 8.3.6 Retained and Biobanked Sample

data.text: For this study, any dose of ALXN1840 greater than that specified in the protocol will be considered an overdose. Overdoses are medication errors that are not considered AEs unless there is an untoward medical occurrence resulting from the overdose.

data.text: As this study is an exploratory study, no formal hypothesis testing is being conducted. Study results will be summarized using descriptive statistics.

data.name: Contraceptive use requirement
data.text: Contraceptive use by men or women should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. Male participants: Male participants, if heterosexually active and with a female spouse or partner of childbearing potential or a pregnant or breastfeeding spouse or partner, must agree to use barrier contraception (male condom) for the duration of the study and for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Male participants must not donate sperm for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female spouses or partners of male participants who are of childbearing potential must use highly effective contraception as defined in Section 10.4, starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before (the male participant's) first study intervention administration and continuing until at least 3 months after the end of their male partner's systemic exposure to the study intervention. Barrier contraception (male condom) is required even with documented medical assessment of surgical success of a vasectomy. For male participants who have had a vasectomy (with documented evidence of azoospermia if possible) and agree to use a male condom for the stated time period, no additional contraceptive method is required by their female partner. Female participants: Female participants or female partners of male participants of childbearing potential (including breastfeeding females), if heterosexually active, must be willing to follow protocol_specified contraception guidance starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before first study intervention administration and continuing for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants must not donate ova for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants who are documented as being of non_childbearing potential as defined in Section 10.4 are exempt from contraception requirements.

Enrollment Definition
data.description: Definition of an enrolled participant
data.text: 'Enrolled' means all participants who sign the informed consent form (ICF), are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day _7 when participants are assigned a participant number.

data.name: SRC Safety Review Before Dose Titration
data.description: Safety Review Committee gate for up_titration from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Safety Concern Preventing Up_Titration
data.description: Condition permitting participant to remain on 15 mg/day
data.text: Dosing will be initiated at 15 mg once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks with an increase to 30 mg after 4 weeks, unless there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk, in which case participants may remain on the 15 mg/day dose for the duration of the study.

data.name: Zinc Washout Condition
data.description: Required zinc_free interval to prevent confounding of fecal copper excretion
data.text: Participants must be off zinc therapy for a minimum of 21 days prior to Day 1; previous treatment with zinc within 21 days prior to Day 1 is exclusionary.

data.name: Chelator Discontinuation for Baseline Assessment
data.description: Chelator therapy stopped to allow pretreatment copper balance measurement
data.text: To assess the copper baseline during the Inpatient Run_in Period, participants will be discontinued from their chelator therapy for approximately 4 days prior to initiating ALXN1840, while maintained on a copper_controlled diet.

data.name: Negative Pregnancy Test Requirement
data.description: Reproductive safety condition for enrollment of women of childbearing potential
data.text: Women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening; urine pregnancy tests must be performed at least every 4 weeks throughout the study.

data.name: Negative Drug/Alcohol Screen Condition
data.description: Substance screening condition at Screening and Day _8
data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day _8 (cannabinoids not tested), or alcohol consumption within 48 hours prior to study intervention administration or positive alcohol breath test at Screening or on Day _8, is exclusionary.

data.name: Dietary Compliance Condition
data.description: Willingness to comply with controlled diet
data.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study are excluded.

data.name: Hepatic Dose Modification Criterion (Bilirubin/ALT)
data.description: Laboratory threshold triggering temporary dosing interruption
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 x ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 x ULN, indicative of liver injury, requires temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Hematologic Dose Modification Criterion (Neutrophils)
data.description: Neutrophil decline threshold triggering dose reduction
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline in neutrophils with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up_titration has occurred, or reduce to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening Condition
data.description: Evidence of neurologic worsening requiring dose decision
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or by neurologic physical exam assessment: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase, or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale must be documented and re_evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening Condition
data.description: Clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening requiring dose decision
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening, which may include but is not limited to suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification and document rationale, re_evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Rechallenge Conditions
data.description: Limits and requirements for rechallenge after dose interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. Participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at 15 mg QOD. Rechallenge after bilirubin_related interruption requires bilirubin below ULN at 15 mg QOD or less frequent dosing and approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor. The Investigator, in consultation with the Medical Monitor, may change dose and dose frequency for participants requiring rechallenge.

data.name: Adaptive Design Condition
data.description: Investigator_implemented adaptive features without protocol amendment
data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study and do not require amendment of the protocol; adaptive features and their limits are described in Table 4.

data.name: Discretionary CRU Retention Condition
data.description: Conditions permitting participant to remain inpatient during Outpatient Period
data.text: At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the Outpatient Period for their own safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Condition
data.description: Condition for extending the Outpatient Period
data.text: To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval; participants will be given additional investigational product for daily dosing, the actual duration will be recorded, and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Clinically Significant ECG/QTcF Finding After Enrollment
data.description: Condition triggering investigator determination of continued participation
data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including but not limited to changes from baseline in QTcF) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed; the review must be documented and any new clinically relevant finding reported as an AE.

data.name: Lost to Follow_up Condition
data.description: Definition and contact requirements for lost to follow_up
data.text: A participant will be considered lost to follow_up if he or she repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted; before being deemed lost to follow_up the Investigator must make every effort to regain contact (where possible 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter).

data.name: Screening to Run_in Period Transition
data.text: Participants who sign the ICF and are eligible are registered/enrolled on Day _7, admitted to the CRU on Day _8, and initiated on a copper_ and molybdenum_controlled diet after registration/inclusion.

data.name: Run_in to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following the Run_in Period (diet equilibration Day _7 to Day _5 and baseline copper/molybdenum balance collection Day _4 to Day _1), participants begin ALXN1840 15 mg/day on Day 1. Participants must have been off zinc for at least 21 days and off chelator therapy for approximately 4 days.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from the CRU on Day 9, or remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain study integrity. During the Outpatient Period, participants confirm daily dosing via SMS text messaging.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient Period 2 Transition
data.text: Discharged participants are re_admitted on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose) for Treatment Period 2; all procedures start on Day 23 and participants remain in house until Day 40. If the Outpatient Period is extended up to 14 additional days, the participant still continues Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Escalation from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day
data.text: After a minimum of 4 weeks at 15 mg/day (Day 1 through Day 28) and SRC review of available safety data through Day 23 for each participant, the dose is increased to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39, unless safety concerns indicate the participant should remain on 15 mg/day.

data.name: Dose Reduction for Neutrophil Decline
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline neutrophils with baseline neutrophils below the reference range: reduce dose to previous dose level if up_titration has occurred, or reduce to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution; weekly repeat testing (may be performed by home healthcare nurse if no study visit scheduled).

data.name: Temporary Dose Interruption for Hepatic Injury
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 x ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 x ULN indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption with weekly repeat testing; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN, with approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor.

data.name: Dose Modification for Neurological or Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: For evidence of neurologic worsening or clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening, the Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose interruption, increase, or decrease based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale must be documented and re_evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Safety Events
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if any of the following occur: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or the Investigator deems it necessary for the participant.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Abnormal Liver Function
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention for abnormal liver function should be considered by the Investigator when a participant meets one of the conditions outlined in the Dose Modification criteria (Section 6.6) or if the Investigator believes it is in the best interest of the participant.

data.name: Continuation in Study After Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow_up, with data collected per the SoA.

data.name: Participant Withdrawal from Study
data.text: A participant may withdraw at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons; the participant is then permanently discontinued from both study intervention and the study, and an early discontinuation visit should be conducted if possible.

data.name: Post_Study Therapy Transition
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods (ie, Day 40), participants will either transition to the therapy discontinued before enrollment, transition to other standard of care therapy as directed by the treating physician, or, at the discretion of the treating physician, request continuation of ALXN1840 under local preapproval access regulations. All participants should return to the CRU for the EOS Visit on Day 54 (+/_ 2 days).

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the Schedule of Activities (End of Study Visit on Day 54 +/_ 2 days). The end of the study is the date the last participant completes the last visit in the SoA.

data.name: Early Termination / Withdrawal by Participant or Investigator
data.description: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request or may be withdrawn at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons. An Early Termination (EOS/ET) visit including full physical examination should be conducted where possible and the reason recorded in source documents and CRF.

data.name: Lost to Follow_up
data.description: A participant who repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and cannot be contacted after documented attempts (where possible 3 telephone calls and a certified letter) will be considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Discontinuation Due to Pregnancy
data.description: Pregnancy or planned pregnancy during the study requires consideration for discontinuation of study intervention.

data.name: Sponsor Termination of Study or Site Closure
data.description: Alexion reserves the right to close the study site or terminate the study at any time for any reason. Reasons for early closure may include failure of the Investigator to comply with the protocol, IRB/IEC or local health authority requirements, Alexion procedures, or GCP; inadequate recruitment; or discontinuation of further study intervention development. If the study is prematurely terminated or suspended, participants will be informed and appropriate therapy/follow_up assured.

data.name: Screen Failure Due to Prohibited Prior Therapy or Substance Use
data.description: Participants with prior ALXN1840/tetrathiomolybdate within 1 year, zinc within 21 days of Day 1, experimental therapy within 90 days or 5 half_lives before screening, positive drug toxicology or alcohol breath test at Screening or Day _8, or unwillingness to complete controlled meals do not proceed into the treatment schedule.

data.name: SRC Safety Review and Titration Decision
data.description: Before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29, the SRC reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant; if safety concerns exist, the participant remains at 15 mg/day for the duration of the study.

data.name: CRU Discharge Decision
data.description: On Day 9, decision whether the participant is discharged to the Outpatient Period or remains in the CRU for safety or to maintain integrity of study conduct.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Decision
data.description: Investigator decision to extend the Outpatient Period up to an additional 14 days with provision of additional investigational product; participant still resumes Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Modification Decision at Safety Laboratory Assessments
data.description: At scheduled laboratory assessments (Days _8, _1, 8, 23, 28) and weekly repeat tests, results are evaluated against dose modification criteria to determine dose reduction, interruption, or restriction of dose increases.

data.name: Rechallenge Decision After Dose Interruption
data.description: Decision to rechallenge (maximum 3 rechallenges) once laboratory parameters resolve, with dose/frequency determined by the Investigator in consultation with the Alexion Medical Monitor.

data.name: Post_Enrollment Clinically Significant Finding Decision
data.description: Investigator or qualified designee determines whether the participant can continue in the study following identification of a clinically significant finding (eg, QTcF change from baseline).

data.name: End of Study Therapy Transition Decision
data.description: At completion of both inpatient periods (Day 40), the treating physician decides whether the participant resumes prior therapy, starts other standard of care therapy, or requests continued ALXN1840 under preapproval access.
